items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1961-06-21
items.q: Well, I know he had it because he gave one to Jerry Heerman's.

ctx.x: Well, I have seen the cover. Have you? Yes. Someone in Chicago has a copy of it, and I think I've seen your... Is that Mr. Hardin or someone by the name? Yes, yes. You know him? Yes.

Well, I know he had it because he gave one to Jerry Heerman's. I believe he did at least. Yes, that was 1909. It would have been 1908, but he said, Well, here, it's pretty near the end of the year. Let's get a very good, fresh date on it. We wait after the first of the year. So, he published that. How many tunes have you had published? That's all. That one? Did you renew it a few years ago? No, I didn't. See? That showed how little I was thinking of that until Jetty Roll came to town. You did? I wrote to the…

They recorded one of yours, Basin Street Stroller, and what was the other one you did? I didn't know. That was later. They didn't record that. Yeah, you did. I thought that the one out there in Portland, Oregon, what is the...
